# Atomic endpoint ownership qualification

Source only, UNRUN. The complete weekly candidate installs the service-only endpoint ownership contract after the private Messenger readers. The full activation fixture uses the actual notification preference schema, reader functions and captured access supplement in `../messenger-private-accounting/`.

`push-subscription-ownership-regression.sql` exercises actual roles, takeover, wrong possession proof, retry, endpoint uniqueness, device replacement, scoped logout and a late preference-trigger failure that must roll back retirement and enrollment together. It creates only synthetic disposable fixture data and rolls back. The full activation runner invokes this regression; invocation remains pending protected admission.

`push-subscription-ownership-concurrency.spec` specifies two-session commit-order cases. It is a specification, not an executable or observed concurrency result. Actual concurrent qualification, client/API tests, inherited-role checks, provider delivery and authenticated device binding remain separate requirements. Database endpoint uniqueness cannot recall a notification already accepted by an external provider.
